cookieConsent.title: Your cookie preferences
cookieConsent.body: No audience measurement or advertising tools are enabled. You can reject or accept optional cookies; your choice will be remembered.
cookieConsent.pageBody: At this stage, the site has no audience measurement or advertising. The Google Maps frame loads only after you click and may send connection data to Google.
cookieConsent.essentialOnly: The baobab-cookie-consent cookie only remembers your choice (essential only or consent for optional cookies).
cookieConsent.preferenceCookie: The contact form is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile; its widget may use technologies required for bot protection when you load it. Links to Google Maps and Waze open their external services.
cookieConsent.futureTracking: No optional tracking is loaded on this prototype, even after acceptance. Any tracking added later must respect your choice before it loads.
